text:
Elena: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — recording + deck here: https://drive.redwood/ah/1767778888 and https://recordings.redwood/ah/1767778888. Quick follow-up with clarifications and owners for the things that bubbled up.

Sam: thanks! can you remind the timeline for Dedicated GA? heard 'Q3ish' in the talk.

Elena: Short answer: GA target is end of Q3 — we're defaulting to 'end of Sep' for planning. Public GA prereqs: SLA docs, autoscale, basic multi-tenant isolation.

Raja: will that affect Dedicated pricing model / commit sizes?

Elena: Yes. Pricing/commit details will be finalized by the enterprise pricing committee next week. Expect a small bump for reserved blocks; we'll publish a migration guide. @Raja please coordinate.

Raja: on it — I'll draft the pricing migration doc. ETA Fri 09/08.

Lina: UX ask — can we get a clear flow for Private onboarding? saw confusion in the Q&A.

Elena: Good call. @Lina please add a 'Private onboarding flow' diagram to the Console docs and link in the customer-facing FAQ.

Yael: SLO question — any change to latency SLOs for Dedicated vs Hosted?

Elena: No change to public latency SLAs; Dedicated will have stricter internal p95 targets but public SLAs will match Hosted for now. @Yael please update the SLO page with clarifying bullets.

Sam: also, folks asked for better examples for canary + fallback when a model variant scales down.

Sam: propose a snippet for SDK + rollout config (JS + Py).

Elena: Great — action items below. I put minimal owners; ping me if you need reassign.

Action items:
- Raja: pricing migration doc + commit-size guidance. due: 1767865288. link: https://docs.redwood/pricing-migration
- Sam: SDK canary + fallback examples (JS + Python). due: 1767941688. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/sdk-canary
- Lina: Private onboarding flow diagram + FAQ blurb. due: 1768028088. doc: https://docs.redwood/private-onboarding
- Yael: update SLO page + internal p95 target note. due: 1767941688. doc: https://docs.redwood/slo

Elena: Also two quick clarifications that kept coming up: 
1) 'Dedicated' = reserved HW + namespace isolation; same API endpoints, same client experience.
2) 'Private' = customer-managed control plane option for regulated setups (VPC/on-prem).

Sam: can we add a short FAQ line in the deck for that distinction?

Elena: yes — added to the deck (slide 3). thanks @Sam.

Notes-bot: Meeting notes saved to https://notes.redwood/ah/1767778888 — transcript + action items added.

Raja: ack, will post the first draft tomorrow.

Lina: will sync with @design-team and post mock update by Tue.

Yael: will open a PR with SLO clarifications.

Sam: thanks Elena, good sync. :thumbsup:

Elena: Thanks all — if anything missing call it out here. I'll follow up with calendar invites for review syncs.
